🫏 New post ready 📖 Story · school days · 7 slides “you were standing by the garden shop counter, holding a small tray of yellow pansies.” 📝 Slides
1. you were standing by the garden shop counter, holding a small tray of yellow pansies. 2. i almost turned back to the potting soil, sure you only remembered the kid who spilled glue on the rug. 3. so i stepped closer and asked if room four still smelled like damp wool on rainy mornings. 4. but you set the tray down, looked over your glasses, and asked if i still kept three pencils in my coat. 5. so we stood by the seed packets for ten minutes while the rain tapped on the glass roof. 6. i told you i spent that whole year sure i was the hardest student you had to manage. 7. you looked down at your shoes and said you put my desk by the window on purpose , so i could watch the birds whenever the room got too loud.
✍️ Caption
some people gave us a quiet spot before we even knew we were overwhelmed. they noticed which corner helped us get through the hour. send this to the teacher who made the room feel a little safer. #childhoodmemories #schoolmemories #teacher #growingup
